projects.title: Blockchain-19
projects.description:
This is an application used to track the validity of the COVID-19 vaccine. An employer or another entity would be able to login and see if a person has received the COVID-19 vaccine.

There is limited visibility within the medical supply chain when it comes to receiving medications or vaccinations. From manufacturers, logistics, hospitals/clinics, and recipients there is a lack of transparency with the process that causes errors, waste of resources (money and time), and are more susceptible to data breaches.

projects.title: Frugal Foodie
projects.description:
Frugal Foodie is an application that generates recipes based on ingredients or weekly sale ads. When using the weekly sale ad feature, the application will produce the least expensive recipe for the user.

This application addresses a few different issues. First is the issue of the amount of time people spend planning for their weekly meals. For those on budget, buying items on sale can save their household a lot of money. One could spend hours looking through ads and coordinating it with their cookbook. This application will also save the user time on deciding on which recipe to make. Eliminating indecisiveness.
